title: Show HN: Giving Opus 5.5 a simulated paint canvas
summary: A Show HN project called 'stillwet.art' that gives a language model (referred to as Opus 5.5) a simulated paint canvas, allowing it to interact with a virtual painting environment. The 290-point HN discussion explores the model's creative output and the technical setup behind simulating artistic tools for an LLM.
